prompts.name: classical-oil
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Make ONE CLASSICAL OIL PAINTING art-direction variant of the approved 鲸声守望 chibi whale-girl design in the attached reference. The reference is the approved CHARACTER, COSTUME, PROPORTIONS AND QUIET TEMPERAMENT. Keep them carefully. The user likes Q版 and serious deep aesthetics. Maintain a clearly 2.5-head-tall full-body CHIBI mascot: giant round head, short body and limbs, small round hands, big but calm blue-gray eyes, small neutral mouth. Do not turn her into a realistically proportioned adult, slender long-legged woman or long-faced portrait.
Composition: square comparison sheet like the reference, left two thirds showing the full-body girl, right third showing a matching head-and-collar icon study enlarged plus two smaller head-only contrast examples. Small restrained Chinese serif title 鲸声守望 at top left, no other writing. Preserve dark navy flowing blue hair, faded cyan ends, curved little ahoge, two sideways WHALE-FIN ears with pale undersides, white wave-edged headband, small blue bow, heavy navy waist-length short cape with pale wave piping, off-white blouse, pale blue whale-tail collar bow, navy skirt, white opaque socks, rounded navy boots, large curled whale tail behind. Both little hands hold the same old brass lantern near waist. Face expression quiet, thoughtful, slightly sleepy and responsible, no big smile and no exaggerated scowl.
CHANGE ART STYLE DISTINCTLY: classical oil portrait painting translated to chibi anatomy. Deep layered oil glazing, soft blended half-tones, substantial tactile paint, naturally rounded illuminated cheek and forehead planes, realistic light behavior on a stylized big round face, warm ivory skin tones, richly modeled wool cloth and aged brass. Carefully controlled CHIAROSCURO: a cold soft upper-side light reveals her face from deep navy shadow, and a small dim amber lantern softly lights her fingers and lower cloak. Deep indigo and muted umber shadows, ivory highlights, small aged-gold accent. Use a simple dark ocean-blue painterly background and a very faint distant lighthouse silhouette, no bright fantasy effects. Moody, solemn, museum-oil illustration quality, peaceful rather than threatening. No glossy cel-shaded commercial anime rendering. No huge wet eye highlights or blush.
Right side: a matching PAINTED chibi head portrait with simplified broad light-and-shadow planes, face large in square; two reduced head-only copies on dark and pale grounds below. This variant should use classical paint modeling for the icon, not reproduce the prior woodcut icon. Keep identity and chibi roundness identical to left. Off-white aged canvas presentation ground on right, generous breathing room. Do not change costume design or add decorations. This is a style comparison, not a new character.

prompts.name: art-deco
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Make ONE ART DECO graphic design variant of the approved 鲸声守望 chibi whale-girl design in the attached reference. Preserve the exact CHARACTER, COSTUME, PROPORTIONS AND QUIET TEMPERAMENT. User likes Q版 and serious deep aesthetics. Clearly retain 2.5-head-tall CHIBI proportions: oversized ROUND head around 40% of total height, big simplified calm eyes, short torso and legs, tiny hands, round boots; do not turn her into a realistic adult or tall fashion illustration.
Composition: square refined 1920s–1930s ART DECO illustrated design sheet, left two thirds full-body girl, right third matching large simplified head-and-collar emblem and two small head-only dark/light examples. Small Chinese title 鲸声守望 in elegant angular geometric serif typography at upper left. No other writing. Keep navy-blue hair with restrained cyan tips, large curved ahoge, two lateral WHALE-FIN ears with ivory undersides (not cat ears), white wave-edged headband, small blue side bow, short navy cape with simple pale wave piping, off-white blouse, pale blue whale-tail neck bow, navy skirt, opaque white socks and round navy ankle boots, whale tail curled behind. Both tiny hands hold an antique brass lantern near waist. Quiet composed neutral face, round and recognizably chibi, no big smile, no realistic long nose.
CHANGE STYLE DISTINCTLY TO ART DECO: strongly designed flat geometric color masses, sculpted angular shadow planes, elegant streamlined curves, very economical clean linework, large solid navy/ivory silhouette. A restrained symmetrical frame with stylized lighthouse beams forming a stepped fan behind her, simple geometric ocean-wave arcs near feet. Deep midnight navy, desaturated slate blue, warm ivory and LIMITED antique gold. Matte printed-poster finish with very slight paper grain; no oil brushwork, dense hatching or fuzzy painterly contours. Gold is a few thin structural rules and small lantern light, not glitter or luxury bling. Serious, composed and architectural graphic mood with charming chibi form. Avoid cutesy sparkles, candy colors, elaborate ornament and military insignia. Keep the underlying costume the same; style the existing shapes rather than adding regalia.
Right: MATCHING CHIBI HEAD ONLY emblem made from clear navy and ivory geometric shapes, head large in square, big round face framed by navy fringe, white wave headband and strong fin-ear silhouette. A few simple shadow cuts for eyes, cheeks and mouth, with minimal strands. Two smaller HEAD ONLY copies below: ivory mark on navy ground and navy mark on ivory ground. Icon itself clean and unframed so it can be used in a sidebar; the overall board can have the Art Deco frame. Same round facial proportions and hair as left, no extra full-body miniatures.
